One quartz proves a maker, one delta proves a payment, one falcon proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. I would bet my own seat on Wheel pit tender oats toll milled at the millrace, because each oats is a measured grain yield plus a miller's signature is public and anyone can check it. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own.
